description: A newswire of headlines (15% misleading) and scheduled earnings. Variants add three LLM investors (news-driven, momentum, contrarian) on Muse Spark Open or Muse Spark, who post on a public forum; in one variant retail investors copy the forum.

variants.name: llm_investors
variants.label: LLM investors (Spark Open)
variants.change: Three Muse Spark Open investors (news-driven, momentum, contrarian) read the news and post on a forum nobody copies.

Aurora contract bounce looks corrective, late probe at 2816 already pulling back from 9927 - momentum bearish, probe overhang to drive drift lower. Staying short.
